releaseNotes:
iPhone Duo
• Delta unfolds in all new ways to take full advantage of iPhone Duo
• Optimized controller skins for every pose in both portrait and landscape
• Supports Split View multitasking with other apps
• Folding Duo puts DS games to sleep, just like closing the lid of a real DS

Sega Genesis
• Delta does what Nintendon’t!
• Sega Genesis games are now playable in Delta
• New controller skins for iPhone and iPad recreate the classic Genesis controller look
• Built-in support for Action Replay and GameGenie cheats

Liquid Glass UI
• Fresh new UI designed from the ground up for Liquid Glass
• Fully adapts to all screen sizes from Duo to iPad
• System icons mark every page in your Game Library
• Default artwork now has a light, glassy look

RetroAchievements
• Sign in with your RetroAchievements account to earn achievements in any supported game
• Supports Hardcore mode, which disables loading save states and using cheats
• Shows your achievement progress when you launch a game

Recents & Favorites
• New "Recently Played" and "Favorites" pages in Game Library
• Quickly jump back in to your most recently played games
• Add games to "Favorites" via long-press for easy access

Animated Controller Skins
• Controller skins come to life with support for fully animated buttons and controls
• Supports 3rd-party skins, so skin creators can make their own 
• Try Delta’s new official animated GBA skin, designed by Caroline Moore

Audio Settings
• New audio settings to control how Delta handles other apps’ audio
• "Mix with Other Audio" keeps music or podcasts playing alongside game audio
• "Pause Other Audio" pauses everything else when a game starts

Game Boy Color Palettes
• Customize how your Game Boy games look with color palettes for original Game Boy games
• Supports all the official color palettes from Game Boy Color

Custom Fast Forward Speeds
• Customize your experience with various Fast Forward speeds set per-game
• Adjust your game’s default speed at any time from the Pause Menu or in Game Settings

Adjustable Screen Position
• Long-press to move your game screen wherever you like when playing with a controller
• Easily move the screen above your favorite faceplate controllers

DLC
• Custom in-game experiences for classic Pokémon games
• Unlock event items, receive rare Pokémon, and more
• Supports all mainline GBA Pokémon games
• First DLC coming soon!

Redesigned Pause Menu
• Fully redesigned & animated pause menu with Liquid Glass
• Large, centered pause menu buttons make navigation simple
• Dynamically adjusts pause menu layout to scale to all window sizes
• Redesigned cheats screen with custom icons for additional customization

Redesigned Settings
• Reorganizes settings into more easily navigable hierarchy
• Displays icons for all top-level settings
• Redesigned controller input mapping screen for game controllers and keyboards
• New Lil’ Settings and Advanced sections for additional customizations

Custom Filters (Experimental Feature)
• Experience your games just how you remember with new custom game filters
• Set your filters per-system to change how games look across all your games
• Choose from a set list of defaults (e.g. CRT) or import your own custom filters from the Files app

Epilogue GB/SN Operator Support (Experimental Feature)
• Use your GB/SN Operator devices with Delta, thanks to the Epilogue team
• Connect game cartridges directly to your iPhone/iPad and play them natively 
• Reads and writes save files to cartridge
• GB and SN operators support GBC/GBA and SNES games respectively
• Blowing into cartridges optional

Misc.
• Added the ability to delete save states in bulk
• Fixed issue causing audio crackling for SNES games
• Fixed NES games occasionally opening to a black screen
description:
Delta is an all-in-one emulator for iOS and iPadOS. Delta builds upon the strengths of its predecessor, GBA4iOS, while expanding to include support for more game systems such as NES, SNES, N64, Nintendo DS, and Sega Genesis.

FEATURES

Supported Game Systems
• Nintendo Entertainment System
• Super Nintendo Entertainment System
• Nintendo 64
• Game Boy (Color)
• Game Boy Advance
• Nintendo DS
• Sega Genesis

Online Multiplayer
• Play online-compatible Nintendo DS games with friends around the world!
• Connect via community Nintendo WFC servers
• Choose one of the default servers, or provide a custom DNS

Controller Support
• Nintendo Switch Pro controllers, Joy-Cons
• Nintendo Switch Online controllers (NES, SNES, N64)
• PS4, PS5
• Xbox One S, Xbox Series X
• MFi game controllers
• Bluetooth & wired keyboards

RetroAchievements
• Sign in with your RetroAchievements account to earn achievements in any supported game
• Supports Hardcore mode, which disables loading save states and using cheats
• Shows your achievement progress when launching a game

Save States
• Save and load save states for any game from the pause menu.
• Lock save states to prevent them from being accidentally overwritten.
• Automatically makes backup save states to ensure you never lose your progress.
• Support for “Quick Saves,” save states that can be quickly saved/loaded with a single button press (requires external controller).

Cheats
• Supports various types of cheat codes for each supported system:
• NES: Game Genie
• SNES: Game Genie, Pro Action Replay
• N64: GameShark
• GBC: Game Genie, GameShark
• GBA: Action Replay, Code Breaker, GameShark
• DS: Action Replay
• Genesis: Action Replay, Game Genie

Delta Sync
• Sync your games, game saves, save states, cheats, controller skins, and controller mappings between devices.
• View version histories of everything you sync and optionally restore them to earlier versions.
• Supports both Google Drive and Dropbox.

Custom Controller Skins
• Beautiful built-in controller skins for all systems.
• Import controller skins made by others, or even make your own to share with the world!
• Supports animated buttons for even more immersion when playing games

Hold Button
• Choose buttons for Delta to hold down on your behalf, freeing up your thumbs to press other buttons instead.
• Perfect for games that typically require one button be held down constantly (e.g. run button in Mario games, or the A button in Mario Kart).

Fast Forward
• Speed through slower parts of games by running the game much faster than normal.
• Easily enable or disable from the pause menu, or optionally with a mapped button on an external controller.
• Customize speed per-game by long-pressing Fast Forward option in pause menu.

3D/Haptic Touch
• Use 3D or Haptic Touch to “peek” at games, save states, and cheat codes.
• App icon shortcuts allow quick access to your most recently played games, or optionally customize the shortcuts to always include certain games.

Game Artwork
• Automatically displays appropriate box art for imported games.
• Change a game’s artwork to anything you want, or select from the built-in game artwork database.

Misc.
• Gyroscope support (WarioWare: Twisted! only)
• Microphone support (DS only)
• Support for delta:// URL scheme to jump directly into a specific game.
